messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: smart-router detected a fallback loop pattern for route=/api/v1/generate (enterprise tier). Increased 5xxs (502/504), repeated region redirects observed. Start: 2026-03-15T17:12:01Z. Auto-escalation: paging oncall.

alex (oncall): On it. paging @jordan (p050) and @maya. Adding channel for visibility. Anyone seeing a deployment/rollout?

jordan (sre): I saw the alert spike. Looking at traceroutes now. Can you confirm which rollout this hit?

maya (eng-runtime): Looks like canary rollout id canary-2026-03-15-17 across eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 fallback path. Canary was set to new variant redwood-llama-70b-q4e canary canary-2026-03-15-17. I see sticky_fallback behavior kicking in and then routing back to the canary variant in next hop -> loop.

ella (support): Support is getting customer escalations — 3 enterprise tenants reporting 30-60s tail latencies and intermittent errors. Tickets created: INC-8472, INC-8473, INC-8474. They're asking ETA.

alex (oncall): Jordan, please take lead on mitigation. Maya, can you dump the routing policy for that rollout? We may need to kill the canary.

jordan (sre): Oncall -> executing quick mitigations: 1) disable sticky fallback on policy 2) pin route to baseline model 3) abort canary if still rolling. Will run changes via admin API.

maya (eng-runtime): Here's the relevant snippet from the routing policy (redacted):

```yaml
routing_policy:
  rollout_id: canary-2026-03-15-17
  canary:
    model_variant: redwood-llama-70b-q4   # OOPS: this is the wrong tag in the service config
    traffic_percent: 10
    sticky_fallback: true
  fallback_sequence:
    - redwood-llama-70b-q4
    - redwood-llama-7b-q4
```

maya (eng-runtime): The intended canary was redwood-llama-70b-q4e (quantized + extended attention). The service config has a mismatch and sticky_fallback=true. When requests fail in eu-west-1 they fallback to us-east-1, which then sticky-routes back to the incorrectly-tagged variant in the canary set -> loop.

alex (oncall): That explains it. Jordan, what's the command to flip sticky_fallback off?

jordan (sre): Running the admin API now:

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://admin.internal/api/v1/routing/policies/canary-2026-03-15-17" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sticky_fallback": false}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]"
```

deploy-bot: Received request to PATCH policy canary-2026-03-15-17. Validating... :gear:

deploy-bot: Policy updated: sticky_fallback=false (audit id audit-20260315-321).

jordan (sre): Done. Now pining route to baseline model to stop any canary routing:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/v1/routing/override" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/api/v1/generate","model_variant":"redwood-llama-70b-q4","duration_seconds":900}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]"
```

deploy-bot: Route override applied for /api/v1/generate -> redwood-llama-70b-q4 for 900s.

jordan (sre): Abort canary job as a precaution. Triggering rollout abort.

maya (eng-runtime): I also removed the mis-tagged variant mapping from the canary set and queued a policy lint job. This was a config drift between the rollout manifest and the model registry tag.

alex (oncall): Monitoring traffic and errors now. Can everyone confirm customer-facing error rate is dropping?

ella (support): Customers report improvement within the last minute, but one tenant still sees intermittent error bursts. I've escalated to priority and will keep them updated: INC-8472 owner updated.

jordan (sre): Metrics look better: 5xx rate down to baseline across eu-west-1 and us-east-1, latency tail recovering. Recovered at 2026-03-15T17:20:45Z. Marking incident as mitigated for now.

choi (pm): Thanks all. High-level customer impact: 3 enterprise tenants, degraded generation quality and increased latency for ~8 minutes, some 502s returned. We'll need a postmortem for the rollout.

maya (eng-runtime): Immediate root cause: rollout config had wrong model_variant tag + sticky_fallback enabled by default for canaries. Contributing factors: no config lint check for variant tag equality with model registry; sticky fallback default too permissive for cross-region canaries.

jordan (sre): Short-term actions: 1) add a guard in routing controller that prevents sticky_fallback across regions when canary traffic_percent < 20% 2) add lint to CI to verify rollout manifest variant matches model-registry resolved id 3) run audits for recent rollouts in last 48h.

maya (eng-runtime): I'll own the CI lint and the registry check (owner: maya). Target: change by 2026-03-18.

alex (oncall): I'll file the incident ticket and schedule a handoff to eng-runtime for daytime follow-ups. Handoff: alex -> maya.

ella (support): I'll update customer tickets with timeline and note that we applied a rollback and override.

choi (pm): Please include SRE, Eng Runtime, Support, and Product in the postmortem. I'll draft the postmortem template and invite stakeholders.

jordan (sre): Logging final mitigations for audit: sticky_fallback disabled, route pinned, canary aborted, config lint job created (job-id lint-20260315-77).

alex (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving channel, handing to maya for follow-ups. :wave: 

maya (eng-runtime): Thanks — I'll follow up with a deeper analysis and remediation plan. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated (mitigation_ts=2026-03-15T17:20:45Z). Postmortem requested: yes.

jordan (sre): FYI — allocating postmortem owner: choi (pm) + maya (eng-runtime) to co-author. Will add timeline and alerts to the doc.

choi (pm): I'll schedule a 30-min bridge for 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC to review findings and next steps.

ella (support): Closing notes: customers notified, CS follow-up scheduled.

alex (oncall): final: incident closed to oncall. Leaving follow-ups to owners. :eyes:
